Ad_evidence: Closed form A_d = C(n,d)(p-1) for the MDS code (RESULTS.md sec 4, verified three ways at p = 23)
distance_evidence: Closed-form MDS distance d = r - k + 2 of the punctured Reed-Solomon (m = 1) code, puncture-invariant (RESULTS.md sec 4; verified by MITM for the p <= 41 members of the family). MITM at this p is infeasible: the 3+3 tables scale as (p-1)^3.
